fields.ONE_LINER: Double-deck vibratory bowl feeder for 3x3 to 50x50 mm parts - interfaces with Panasonic CM602, Juki, Fuji and ASM.
fields.NARRATIVE: Two decks keep a buffer of oriented parts in front of the pick head, so a refill does not stop the line. The transfer track is built to sit on the feeder bank of the machines you already run.
fields.SPEC_06: 06  COMPATIBILITY         Panasonic CM602 / Juki / Fuji / ASM
fields.APP_01: Odd-form parts on an existing SMT line
fields.HERO_MEDIA: BF-2002D double-deck bowl with parts oriented on the track, 3/4 view or muted looping MP4
fields.MARQUEE_MEDIA: bowl vibration / part orientation / track transfer / pick by SMT head / refill / integration on a CM602 bank
